```plaintext
1 (Currently Amended) A cell comprising: a non-native compartment comprising a proteinaceous shell comprising at least one bacterial microcompartment (BMC) polypeptide, wherein the non-native compartment is formed by a plurality of distinct BMC polypeptides.

5 (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 3 wherein the at least one targeted enzyme comprises a compartment-specific targeting signal sequence and wherein the compartment-specific targeting signal sequence is selected from the group consisting of linker peptides and signal peptides.

12 (Currently Amended) A method comprising: introducing into a host cell a polynucleotide that encodes at least one BMC polypeptide, wherein the host cell is transformed such that the polynucleotide that encodes at least one BMC polypeptide is expressed, and growing the transformed cell under conditions effective for the transformed cell to produce a non-native compartment comprising a proteinaceous shell comprising the at least one BMC polypeptide that catalyzes conversion of a substrate to a product.

21 (Currently Amended) A method comprising: providing a cell comprising a non-native compartment comprising: a proteinaceous shell comprising at least one bacterial microcompartment (BMC) polypeptide, and at least one enzyme that catalyzes conversion of the substrate to a product, wherein the enzyme catalyzes converting a substrate to a bioactive product; and growing the cell under conditions effective for the at least one enzyme to catalyze conversion of the substrate to a product.
```
